title: Minimal daily DAG
body: Create a DAG `hello_etl` with schedule `@daily`, catchup=False, one BashOperator printing logical date.
solution:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.bash import BashOperator
from pendulum import datetime

with DAG(
    dag_id="hello_etl",
    start_date=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tz="UTC"),
    schedule="@daily",
    catchup=False,
) as dag:
    BashOperator(
        task_id="print_ds",
        bash_command="echo Processing {{ ds }}",
    )

title: Pull XCom in Bash
body: Task pulls row_count from task_id `push` using Jinja.
solution:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.python import PythonOperator
from airflow.operators.bash import BashOperator
from pendulum import datetime

def push(**context):
    context["ti"].xcom_push(key="row_count", value=42)

with DAG("xcom_pull", start_date=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tz="UTC"), schedule="@daily", catchup=False) as dag:
    push = PythonOperator(task_id="push", python_callable=push)
    show = BashOperator(
        task_id="show",
        bash_command="echo rows={{ ti.xcom_pull(task_ids='push', key='row_count') }}",
    )
    push >> show

title: TaskGroup staging
body: Wrap two tasks in TaskGroup `staging` between extract and load.
solution:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from airflow.utils.task_group import TaskGroup
from pendulum import datetime

with DAG("tg_dag", start_date=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tz="UTC"), schedule="@daily", catchup=False) as dag:
    extract = EmptyOperator(task_id="extract")
    load = EmptyOperator(task_id="load")
    with TaskGroup("staging") as staging:
        clean = EmptyOperator(task_id="clean")
        validate = EmptyOperator(task_id="validate")
        clean >> validate
    extract >> staging >> load

title: Branch on empty file
body: BranchPythonOperator: if file size 0 return `skip_load` else `load`.
solution:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.python import BranchPythonOperator
from airflow.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from pendulum import datetime
import os

def choose(**context):
    path = f"/data/{context['ds']}.csv"
    return "skip_load" if not os.path.getsize(path) else "load"

with DAG("branch_empty", start_date=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tz="UTC"), schedule="@daily", catchup=False) as dag:
    branch = BranchPythonOperator(task_id="branch", python_callable=choose)
    load = EmptyOperator(task_id="load")
    skip_load = EmptyOperator(task_id="skip_load")
    branch >> [load, skip_load]

title: DAG factory pattern
body: Function build_dag(team) returns DAG; register two DAGs for finance and ops.
solution:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from pendulum import datetime

def build_dag(team: str) -> DAG:
    with DAG(
        dag_id=f"etl_{team}",
        start_date=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tz="UTC"),
        schedule="@daily",
        catchup=False,
        tags=[team],
    ) as dag:
        EmptyOperator(task_id="start")
    return dag

globals()["etl_finance"] = build_dag("finance")
globals()["etl_ops"] = build_dag("ops")
